about: Default backdrops (dungeon/art.py backdrop): pictures of generic places, shown behind the story when nobody has made a picture of the place. Made once with scripts/art/backdrops.py (Windows/backdrops.bat); the images are assets/backdrops/<id>.webp, and <id>-night.webp for an outdoor one. A backdrop is picked by a place's own `backdrop`, then a hex site or terrain, a blank lot's entry, the most shared tags, the kind, the street, the default.
backdrop_style: Painterly digital fantasy art with the crisp, saturated finish of a full-dive video game world, dramatic light, wide establishing shot
backdrop_avoid: people, figures, text, lettering, signs with words, watermark, logo

keyart.prompt: Key art for a dark LitRPG tower world. An impossibly tall tower rising through the clouds, its floors stacked like different worlds (a forest floor, a desert floor, a glass city floor, a burning floor) seen through vast arches; at its foot a crowded stone plaza with a glowing cyan waystone obelisk and translucent game-interface light panels hanging in the air with no readable writing; tiny silhouettes of newly arrived people looking up. Awe and menace. Open sky in the upper left third.
keyart.avoid: text, lettering, words, title, logo, watermark, readable interface text

backdrops.prompt: The common room of an adventurers' tavern inside a vast tower: stone arches, a roaring hearth, long tables with tankards and dice, a quest board of pinned notices, lanterns.
A porters' alehouse by a landing: low beams, kegs, a plank bar, worn stools, ropes and packs by the door.
A cheap rented room in a tower town: a narrow bed, a hook for armour, a washbasin, a slit window onto a stone drop.
Soldiers' barracks in a walled keep: rows of bunks, weapon racks, armour stands, a brazier.
A street food stall under an awning: skewers over coals, steaming pots, a queue rope, painted price boards.
A tea stall at a gate: a copper urn, cups on a plank, crates for seats, travellers' packs piled.
An arms and gear shop: racks of swords and spears with graded tags, armour on stands, a forge glowing in the back, a counter with a ledger.
A market street inside a colossal tower: stalls under hanging lanterns, crates of goods, banners, the stone ceiling far above lit by shafts of light.
A small shop in a tower town: shelves of supplies, potions in corked bottles, rope and lanterns, a counter.
A craftsman's workshop in a tower: benches, tools, a hearth, materials in crates.
A small stone chapel with a single lamp burning, plain benches, an altar of scales.
A village green in a walled hill town: grass, a waystone with notices, a well, stone cottages.
A plain stone room someone lives in: a cot, a chest, a hearth, a lamp.
A huge plaza around a glowing waystone obelisk, the safe zone of a tower: a list of names carved on the stone, guild banners, a scrivener's stall, arches leading off.
A massive gate onto a winding stone stair that climbs into darkness: toll booths, guards' posts, torches, a carved arch.
An adventurers' guild hall: a grand room with trophies, a recruitment board, long tables, banners of the guilds.
A porters' yard: stacked packs and crates, ropes and harnesses, a hiring board, carts.
A moneylender's counting house: ledgers, scales, stacks of coin, an iron safe, contracts sealed in wax.
A night market lit by braziers and fire pits: stalls of salvaged gear, smoke, sparks, painted debt boards.
A spice exchange: sacks and bins of coloured spice, brass scales, a price board, hanging lamps.
A shadowy alley of fences' stalls: covered tables of stolen goods, lanterns turned low, a lookout's stool.
A charm sellers' row: stalls hung with amulets and talismans with graded tags, incense, little bottles.
A map and paper shop: rolled maps of tower floors, a drafting table, ink pots, a wall of route charts.
An opulent salon: lanterns of coloured glass, silk cushions and couches, a dance floor, curtained alcoves, no people.
A freight wharf at night on a floor with an underground sea: cranes, cargo nets, a hanging cage, lamps on posts.
A town crier's post: a raised platform with a bell, a board of bounties and news.
Water sellers' stand: great clay jars, a pump, tin cups, a ration board.
A towering gothic cathedral nave: soaring pillars, an enormous pair of carved scales over the altar, candles, stained glass.
A convent's cloister: arched walkway around a garden, a fountain, plain cells off the walk.
A monastic infirmary: rows of cots, white linen, herbs drying, a table of instruments.
Prison pens by a river: iron cages on stone, chains, a guard's stool, water running below.
A margrave's great hall: a high seat, long tables, banners, a huge hearth, hunting trophies.
A lord's private solar: a harp, a window seat, tapestries, a small table laid for lunch.
A rampart walk on a great wall: crenellations, horns on hooks, a watch fire, the land beyond.
Catacomb galleries: niches stacked with skulls and bones, a narrow stair down, candle stubs.
A drill ground: packed earth, straw dummies, weapon racks, a fence.
A stone watermill on a river: a big wheel turning, sacks of flour, millstones inside.
An old stone bridge over a river, a road across it, a carved marker.
An old cemetery with beehives among the graves, honeycomb, wild flowers.
A lone tower room high up, a view through a window over a vast landscape.
A border ditch and earthwork under a grey sky, stakes, a parley flag, huge footprints.
A dusty frontier town on a western-themed floor: false-front saloons, hitching posts, a water tower, a dirt street, a painted sky.
A feudal castle town under curfew at dusk: wooden machiya houses, paper lanterns, a white castle above.
A neon-lit cyberpunk stack of towers in endless rain: holographic signs, cables, wet streets, steam.
A horror-themed hospital at night: a long corridor, flickering lights, empty gurneys, a wheelchair.
Post-apocalyptic ash wastes: grey dunes, rusted wrecks, a broken highway sign, a dull sun.
A dark magic undercroft: vaulted stone, glowing runes, pools of black water, floating motes of light.
Rolling green hills with beacon towers and the far-off shapes of giants.
Stilt villages over reed marsh: huts on poles, rope causeways, boats, reeds.
A fog-wrapped landing platform at the top of the Stair, a notice board, railings over a drop.
A broken bridge span on a chalk-white floor, the stair ending in air.
A new floor of a colossal tower seen from its landing: a whole land under a vaulted sky, a painted horizon, a road leading away.
